description: Shared GitLab MCP HTTP endpoints for the Juno SDLC platform (no secrets). CloudFront is for IDE/read paths; apps-repo publish MUST use direct ALB + single commit.

waf.note: GenericLFI_BODY excluded on CloudFront Web ACL CreatedByCloudFront-0a676d76 (one-time AWS console/CLI change). Publish still must not use CloudFront — historical per-file path flooded Sidekiq PostReceive.

usage.gitlabAgentPublish: directMcpUrl only + one gitlab_commit_create per app (GITLAB_PUBLISH_SINGLE_COMMIT=true); never CloudFront
usage.albFallback: directMcpUrl (not used as CloudFront fallback for publish)

defaultAgents.note: Non-publish agents may use CloudFront for reads; publish path always prefers GITLAB_MCP_HTTP_DIRECT_URL
